demandEvidence.chore: Prepare customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’d be interested to hear how others handle customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.

ease.reason: A student can test draft updates from synthetic status rows, but no supplied reference supports data connections or messaging.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: online shops might pay for clearer status updates; this discussion establishes neither buyer intent nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can draft from fictional changing status rows; live access, useful fields and factual accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed input-to-draft loop is narrow, but no implementation capability is documented and a person must verify facts and approve messages.

evidence.reason: The discussion directly raises customer-facing updates when operational data changes or is incomplete, but gives no frequency or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow synthetic-input draft experiment. It is below the 6 threshold, with no supplied implementation reference for store connections or messaging; a human must verify and approve each update.
